errors.evidence: The slice for '身体动作' (Body Movement) is light blue, not '浅绿色' (light green).
The slice for '生理活动' (Physiological Activity) is dark blue, not '深紫色' (dark purple).
The description incorrectly assigns the value 5.57% to '战争' (War). In the chart, 5.57% corresponds to '文教' (Culture/Education), and '战争' is 8.87%.
This is the second mention of '战争' (War), while the category '文教' (Culture/Education) with a value of 5.57% is completely omitted from the description of the left pie chart.
The right pie chart has 10 sub-categories, not 11.
The slice for '心理活动' (Psychological Activity) is a dusty pink/mauve color, not '浅棕色' (light brown).
The slice for '司法' (Judicial) is very dark, almost black, not '浅蓝色' (light blue).
The slice for '争斗' (Struggle/Fight) is a dark magenta/purple, not '浅红色' (light red). The description also uses '斗争' instead of '争斗' as labeled in the chart.
The slice for '判断' (Judgment) is a light cyan/blue-green color, not '灰色' (grey).
The slice for '表情' (Expression) is light orange, not '黄色' (yellow).
The slice for '交通' (Traffic/Communication) is a brownish color, not '深灰色' (dark grey).

This statement is incorrect and misleading. The slices in both pie charts are not arranged in descending order of their percentage values. For instance, in the left chart, the largest slice (23.3%) is next to a much smaller one (9.48%).
